title: Eligibility Category Table — Most RideLink Value-Added Trips Carried into a New Year
content:
The number of unused Non-Emergency Medical Transportation value-added trips a member may carry into the next benefit year is limited according to the eligibility category of the member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership.

**Rule.** The most trips a member may carry follows the eligibility category of the active plan membership: Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care carries up to the prenatal carry cap of 6 trips; Prairie Ridge Family Care, Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid and Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids carry up to the family carry cap of 3 trips; every other category carries none. The trips carried are the smaller of this limit and the unused trips that may otherwise be carried.

## Category table

| Eligibility category of the active membership | Most trips carried |
|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 6 |
| Prairie Ridge Family Care | 3 |
| Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | 3 |
| Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids | 3 |
| Any other category | None |

## Cases

*Hypothetical members:*

- Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care, a limit of 6 and 9 unused trips that may otherwise be carried: 6 are carried.
- Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids, a limit of 3 and 2 unused trips that may otherwise be carried: 2 are carried, the smaller of the two.
- A category outside the table: the category itself allows no trips to be carried.
